vocabulary_focus.concept: How are you? / How's it going?

expressions.en: How are you? / How's it going?
expressions.cn: 你好吗？/ 怎么样？ (Nǐ hǎo ma? / Zěnme yàng?)

vocabulary_focus.concept: Can I help you? / How may I assist?

expressions.en: Can I help you? / How may I assist?
expressions.cn: 我能帮你吗？/ 有什么可以帮到你？ (Wǒ néng bāng nǐ ma? / Yǒu shénme kěyǐ bāng dào nǐ?)
expressions.bm_formal: Ada apa yang boleh saya bantu? / Bagaimana saya boleh membantu anda?
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh saya tolong? / Nak saya tolong?

expressions.cn: 我明白了 / 懂了 (Wǒ míngbái le / Dǒng le)
你能再说一遍吗？/ 什么？ (Nǐ néng zài shuō yī biàn ma? / Shénme?)
expressions.bm_formal: Boleh anda ulang semula? / Maaf, boleh ulang?

vocabulary_focus.concept: Thank you very much / Appreciate it

expressions.en: Thank you very much / Appreciate it
expressions.cn: 非常感谢 / 谢谢 (Fēicháng gǎnxiè / Xièxiè)
expressions.bm_formal: Terima kasih banyak-banyak / Saya amat menghargainya

expressions.cn: 不好意思 / 借过 (Bù hǎoyìsi / Jièguò)

work.scenario: You're new to the team and need to understand project instructions from your manager. A colleague offers help, and you need to confirm understanding.

life.scenario: You're at a crowded pasar malam (night market) trying to get through. You also bump into an acquaintance and want to greet them.

tech.scenario: You're trying to set up a new smart device, but the instructions are unclear. You ask a friend for help, but miss a crucial step and need them to repeat it.
